The '''''Cal Ambre''''' was a heavily modified [[Cal-class battleship|''Cal''-class battleship]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Cal Ambre'' started out as a [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]], but by the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] served as a luxury gambling liner. Most of its weaponry was removed prior to conversion, but the [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver]] was maintained as a piece in the game "[[Bombarde]]." Two [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] were used to defend the ship and to break larger asteroids. The six [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors were used to move the asteroid fragments into the mass driver cannon.<ref name="CRO" />

The ship could support 9,000 passengers and much room had been refurbished to function as hotel suites, dancing and gambling halls, malls, theaters and parks.<ref name="CRO" />

==History==
During the time of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], [[Callia's]], an antique shop, was located aboard the ''Cal Ambre''. The shop was situated on the main mall level, between [[Larjh StarCorporation]] and an exclusive clothier. The owner of his store, [[Retter Lewis]] and his employees used this shop as a cover for a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] transportation network. Many [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] dignitaries visited the ship for entertainment, which made it a ideal transfer spot for defectors.<ref name="CRO" />

The ship remained in a permanent orbit near the moon [[Rove]] in the [[Bramior system/Legends|Bramior system]], because the moon was an important part of the "Bombarde" installment. There was no Imperial presence on the ship, but a frigate remained in the system to provide security in case of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attack.<ref name="CRO" />
